**hypothesis**: Plain English: does giving the critic a head start (actor frozen, critic still learning) before PPO resumes fix the credit-assignment blindness the turn-authority campaign found, rather than the actor immediately drifting the behavior while the critic is still catching up? probe_yaw_credit found the critic's forward value_delta is BLIND/PUNISHES on this exact turnpay-canary checkpoint at 2M already (15/16 probes across this whole lineage) and V is near-degenerate-constant across command signs -- but every acquisition arm so far co-trains actor+critic from step 0, so the critic never gets a stationary target to learn against before the actor (which already has real turn authority from mirror-aug BC) starts moving under a value function that cannot yet defend it. This is the SAME base/recipe as the already-FAILED turnpay-acq1 (ACQ FAIL - TURN EROSION, wz_med decayed to +0.024/+0.034,-0.069/-0.073) with exactly ONE new variable: --actor-lr=0.0003 (== the run's own constant --lr, so unfrozen behavior is identical) + --actor-freeze-steps=8000000 (~21% of the 38M budget) so the critic alone updates on the canary's frozen, already-turning policy for the first 8M steps before any actor drift can begin -- a genuine value-warmup phase, not the density/pricing-magnitude levers already refuted (turndense1, stillbal, yaw5x). Also fixed a real gap this required: train_ppo_mjx.py's critic-marker split previously misclassified the dual-core critic's own recurrent trunk (lstm_critic) as ACTOR, which would have frozen the critic's encoder too and defeated the whole point -- fixed + tested this cycle (test_value_learning.py, 25/25 green), 0 prior --actor-lr+--gru* combos existed to have caught it. Prediction-if-true: probe_yaw_credit run on the 8M snapshot (still-frozen boundary) flips from CREDIT-BLIND/PUNISHES to CREDIT-REWARDS (corr>=+0.15) on most of the 4 wz_cmd x seed-probe combos, AND probe_turn_authority wz_med at that same snapshot still reads near the canary's own +0.13/-0.18 (unchanged, since the actor never moved) -- confirming the freeze mechanically worked and giving the critic a real chance. Prediction-if-false: probe_yaw_credit stays BLIND/PUNISHES even after 8M critic-only steps against a STATIONARY policy -- ruling OUT co-training non-stationarity as the cause and pointing at a genuine representational/capacity limit (the wz-reward component's variance is too small relative to the dominant terms for MSE-return regression to resolve it) as the next, harder architecture fix (multi-head/reward-decomposed critic).
